messages:
maria: deploy-bot: release v2.8.3 completed. starting gradual APAC traffic shift (5% -> 20%). post-deploy smoke probes kicking off.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary group 1 -> 20% traffic in apac; smoke checks: all green in us/eu. id=dpl-182912

samir: seeing increase in apac healthcheck failures — 5xx from edge-proxy. alert fired: apac-smoke-healthcheck > 1%.

cheng: link to alert: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/12345 :eyes:

maria: can you paste a couple sample logs? small snippets are fine.

samir: logs: ```proxy_apac error backend_timeout host=embed-svc path=/v1/generate count=4 2026-11-03T11:12:05Z```

cheng: i ran curl from an apac canary host: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.apac.redwood/v1/health` -> `503 0.87s`

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: paging cheng (oncall) — high apac smoke failures

cheng: checking routing configs now. no recent infra deploys other than this release. deploy included a kv-cache kernel opt; wondering if redis pool pressure is exposed in apac.

maria: decision needed: pause rollout, pin apac to previous model binary, or full rollback? what's the risk to global prod traffic if we leave at 20%?

samir: at 20% apac (~10k qps) errors are tail timeouts. us/eu unaffected. suggestion: pause the rollout, increase probe cadence, and reduce apac weight back to 5% while we investigate.

praveen: +1 to pause. also recommend pinning model to v2.8.2 in apac (route rule) until we confirm root cause.

cheng: i can push the route pin now: `redwood route pin --region apac --model v2.8.2 --until 2026-11-03T13:00Z`

maria: do it and post status here.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing-rule updated. apac weight reverted to 5%. model pin v2.8.2 applied for apac. id=rt-907

samir: re-running probes in 2m — failures down to 0.2% after the pin. looks like a strong signal.

maria: ok hold the rollout. cheng, investigate kv-cache / redis connections and share runbook outputs. we'll keep the pin until patch or more confidence.

cheng: will check connection pools + client metrics and try to repro under canary load. creating follow-up ticket and will attach logs.

maria: :thumbsup: filing release note: 'APAC rollout paused due to transient backend timeouts; model pinned to v2.8.2 in APAC region. investigation in progress.'

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: thread closed by maria.
